license_note: Google provides Gemini 3.8 Flash as a managed service under the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service, which incorporate the Google APIs Terms of Service. The terms permit customer applications but prohibit developing competing models and reverse engineering, extracting, or replicating model components such as parameter weights, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to Gemini 3.8 Flash through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, including the incorporated Google APIs Terms of Service; no weight license

access_boundary: This record represents the stable release identified by the model code gemini-3.8-flash (generally available September 2, 2026; inputs text, image, video, audio, PDF; output text). No shutdown date is announced. The Cyber-only variant, the 3.7, 3.6, and 3.5 Flash siblings, the flash preview, the pro-preview line, image and audio-only releases, the Gemini consumer app, and the Vertex AI and AI Studio platforms themselves are separate model, service, or application boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a generally available model code with full modality matrix, thinking levels, token limits, release date, and knowledge cutoff
Identity is corroborated across the API latest-model guide, the release changelog, the deprecations table, the models index, and a DeepMind model card
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release deprecates sampling parameters and thinking-budget configs, so existing integrations must migrate
